description: Source code for the CTLogVerifier class, which handles verification of Certificate Transparency logs, including signature verification, consistency proofs, and audit proofs.

classes.name: CTLogVerifier
classes.description: Class responsible for verifying Certificate Transparency log signatures, consistency proofs, and audit proofs.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a CTLogVerifier instance with a public key and description.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies a SignedEntryData against a SignedCertificateTimestamp.

methods.name: VerifySignedTreeHead
methods.description: Verifies a SignedTreeHead's signature and root hash.

methods.name: SignatureParametersMatch
methods.description: Checks if the signature's parameters match expected hash and signature algorithms.

methods.name: VerifyConsistencyProof
methods.description: Verifies a Merkle consistency proof between two tree hashes.

methods.name: VerifyAuditProof
methods.description: Verifies a Merkle audit proof for inclusion of a leaf hash in a root hash.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the verifier with a public key, setting up cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature over given data using the public key.
